links.outcome: Positive predictive value and false positives before vs after local tuning with small external dataset
links.effect: PDA-Alpha had seven false-positive predictions vs one for PDA-Beta; PPV increased from 0.525 to 0.886 (p = 0.041); AUC 0.993 vs 0.986.
links.quote: The positive predictive value increased from 0.525 to 0.886 after external validation (p = 0.041).

links.outcome: Performance of model developed at one center when tested on data from a second center
links.effect: PDA-Alpha detected 49/50 pneumothorax radiographs at the new center but had seven false positives and a PPV of 0.525 before tuning.
links.quote: Both algorithms successfully detected the presence of pneumothorax on 49/50 radiographs; however, PDA-Alpha had seven false-positive predictions, whereas PDA-Beta had one.

links.outcome: Algorithm sensitivity/specificity compared with physicians on the same test data
links.effect: Physicians' sensitivity 0.585 and specificity 0.988; algorithms detected 49/50 pneumothoraces (sensitivity 0.98) but with more false positives (PDA-Alpha 7, PDA-Beta 1).
links.quote: The physicians' sensitivity and specificity for detecting pneumothorax were 0.585 and 0.988, respectively.
